scenarios.name: fodhelper_uac_bypass
scenarios.description: Real capture: after PowerShell points the user's ms-settings shell-open command at a payload, auto-elevating fodhelper.exe starts a hidden, encoded PowerShell that connects to 10.10.10.5:80 and runs whoami.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WORKSTATION5.theshire.local: process fodhelper.exe. Review this process and its related activity.
scenarios.label_note: Accepted: the bypass is set up by registry writes (T1112) and starts a hidden (T1564.003), encoded (T1027, T1140) PowerShell (T1059.001) that reaches a web server (T1071.001, T1105) and runs whoami (T1033).
